g.text: Terms: HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · ID = identifier · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · ROLE-nnn =
project role in the tailoring record (simulated until the lead says otherwise) · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-RISKDEF-001 = the project's tailored risk
definitions (standards/tailoring) · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
